notes.title: Deathmatch Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

MinigolfVR’s deathmatch game mode is now live! If you’ve got the game, feel free to jump in and try it with your friends.

Deathmatch mode brings Minigolf-meets-Mario-Kart style gameplay, giving players item pickups that allow them to mess with other players.

Also, I’ve now implemented a ‘Move directly to ball’ option for those that asked. Simply open up the menu and hit ‘move to ball’.

The next big update will feature local multiplayer, as it’s been the most heavily requested feature. I should be able to have it out within the next week. I’ll also be starting work on a new course, which I hope to have out by the end of the month.

CV1 support has been temporarily delayed due to Home only being installable on C:/, which I don’t have room on. Once I can install it elsewhere, I’ll be starting development of the CV1 version for Oculus Home.

notes.title: MinigolfVR progress update
notes.content:
Hey folks,

I've been hard at work implementing Deathmatch mode. The good news is that it should be out sometime in the next week. Two at the absolute most.

V1 of Deathmatch mode will feature the following items

- Grenade - Used to push balls around
- Smoke Bomb - Obscures sections of the course
- Fan - Blow balls around, clears smoke
- Airhorn - Makes a loud noise. Useful for distracting people
- Party Popper - Creates distracting confetti
- Levitation pad - Makes it easy to hit the ball over obstacles

Check out the progress video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rhcv3F0AjdU&feature=youtu.be
